title: Differential Diagnosis Table
description: A head-to-head differential table for a single target disorder: the conditions that share features with it and how each is distinguished.

target.description: The disorder whose differential is described.

targetDescription.description: Brief original characterization of the target disorder.

disorder.description: Competing condition to consider and rule out.

distinction.description: How this condition is distinguished from the target (original wording).

table.description: Cross-reference to the competing disorder's own table id, if present.
